scope.appliesTo: physically owned 0HP part/retained wreck plan, same physical item
excludes: destroyed invalid enum/weapon ownership P0; must fail closed first
scope.authority: Existing R3VehicleModel.Price(part.Kind,part.Weapon) supplies purchase price; item IDs and part state remain unchanged.

proposal.specialPurchasePrice1: DECISION_REQUIRED: positive rebuild price cannot be strictly cheaper than P=1; current RepairCost==0 means no repair transaction. Codex/HQ explicitly choose free-rebuild entitlement with separate API or exception; never silently set zero and leave a 0HP item unrepairable.
proposal.quoteRequirement: Before invoking repair show owned ID/condition, PURCHASE price P, REBUILD price Q, savings P-Q, sufficient/insufficient Scrap. Preserve quote consistency if buy price changes during same UI interaction.
proposal.transactionRequirement: If funds/validity/ownership/structural gate denies rebuild, no item, Scrap, ownership or group state may mutate. Successful rebuild charges exactly Q once; same ID restored to HP=1 and correct location/inventory.
proposal.economicSafety: No free repeated payout or value creation via rebuild->dismantle->buy loops; do not implement loaner or delayed queue without HQ authority.
proposal.temporaryPartialDamage: Retain existing >0HP RepairCost formula pending separate balance tuning.

scenarioAcceptance.steps: Owned Wheel 0HP, P=15, Scrap=10; quote and repair once
scenarioAcceptance.pass: Q=10, saving=5, restored original ID at full HP, Scrap goes to 0

scenarioAcceptance.steps: Owned Gun Basic 0HP, P=30, Scrap=19; attempt rebuild
scenarioAcceptance.pass: Rebuild rejected, no mutation; quote 20; purchase 30

scenarioAcceptance.steps: Owned Gun Basic 0HP, P=30, Scrap=20; repair twice
scenarioAcceptance.pass: First repair charges 20 exactly once and restores original ID; second repair charges 0 and returns no positive transaction

scenarioAcceptance.steps: 0HP owned weapon enum invalid or duplicate ID; attempt price, rebuild, salvage and dismantle
scenarioAcceptance.pass: Fail closed, no inventory/Scrap mutation, no reward; existing CV-01 takes priority

scenarioAcceptance.steps: Mounted 0HP retained gun plan under selected A/B and two-family cap
scenarioAcceptance.pass: Same type/family and physical ID preserved; no third-family bypass, no phantom gun
User can view Q but no mutation; no invented free loaner, no dead-end fix unless RUN-SAFETY HQ-approved
